notes: GAAP audit. Governmental lines from the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances - Governmental Funds, Total Governmental Funds column (p5). Transfers: Total column prints one net line 'Transfers from (to) other funds' (33,421), recorded as transfers_out as printed (as in FY2024); per fund Street in 110,000, Sales Tax out 17,617, Debt Service out 125,804 (net to the Sewer Fund). Beginning fund balance 3,278,001 as originally reported = as restated (Total column restatement '-'; per-fund restatements General (1,037,611), Sales Tax 892,457, Keno 145,154 net to zero), so no adjustment recorded. Roll-forward 3,278,001 + 4,563,361 - 3,948,396 - 33,421 = 3,859,545 ties. Ending cash = Cash and cash equivalents 3,813,278 on the governmental funds Balance Sheet (p4) Total column; county treasurer cash 31,767 separate (as in FY2024); beginning cash not printed. Business-type from the proprietary Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Net Position (p7) Total column, cost-type lines with function utilities; 'Other revenue' 12,296 counted in Charges for Services by the Statement of Activities; total expenses 931,303 (operating 915,439 + interest 15,864) as printed on the Statement of Activities p2. Balance sheet: government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1), lines by Governmental / Business-type column; 'Unavailable revenue' is printed among liabilities (recorded as unearned revenue); long-term obligations split current / noncurrent as printed. Detail: General Fund from the departmental combining statement (p14-17, 19 department columns, more detailed than the General Fund budget schedule p9, which is therefore not recorded); department functions follow the statement's function split, which ties exactly: general government = Administrative (excl. economic development and capital outlay rows) + Municipal Building + Grants + Employee Insurance + Equipment = 417,235; public safety = Police + Rescue + Fire Maintenance (excl. capital) = 268,314; public works (streets/highways) = Street Lighting + Tree Dump + Cemetery (excl. capital) = 111,209; environment and leisure (culture/recreation) = Activity & Education + Youth Rec Center + Park + Pool + Library + Auditorium + Senior (excl. capital) = 923,999; economic development = Administrative 48,472 + Sales Tax department 777 = 49,249; capital outlay 101,604. No budget column on the departmental schedule. Street, Sales Tax, Debt Service and Capital Projects funds from their budgetary comparison schedules (budget basis, which differs from the GAAP statement columns, e.g. Street sales tax 129,800 vs 127,403; Capital Projects capital outlay 420,714 vs 358,519). Lines with no actual not recorded: Street capital outlay (budget 279,000). Net transfers in the budget schedules are outside the printed totals. Keno fund has no schedule (no detail).
